rules.name: Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no backend, so there are no server-side object endpoints to protect.
rules.detectionMethod: Server-side behaviour test: authenticated user A requests objects owned by user B and must be denied.
rules.remediation: Enforce per-object ownership checks on the server for every object identifier.
rules.verification: Authorization test suite against the running backend with two distinct accounts.
rules.evidence: Test request/response pairs showing denial of cross-account access.

rules.name: Mass Assignment Protection
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no backend that binds client input to server-side models.

officialReference.title: OWASP ASVS V5 Validation and V13 API

rules.detectionMethod: Server-side test: send extra privileged fields (role, isAdmin, ownerId) and verify they are ignored or rejected.
rules.remediation: Use explicit allow-lists of bindable fields; never bind request bodies directly to persistence models.
rules.verification: API test submitting unexpected fields to create/update endpoints.
rules.evidence: Test output showing privileged fields were not persisted.

rules.name: Token Lifetime (MASVS-AUTH)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not issue or store authentication tokens.
rules.detectionMethod: Inspect token issuance configuration and run server tests for expiry of access and refresh tokens.
rules.remediation: Use short-lived access tokens, bounded refresh token lifetime and rotation.
rules.verification: Backend token configuration review plus expiry tests.
rules.evidence: Token issuer configuration and expiry test results.

rules.name: Logout Revocation (MASVS-AUTH)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not issue or store authentication tokens, so there is nothing to revoke on logout.
rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: after logout the previous refresh and access tokens must be rejected.
rules.remediation: Revoke refresh tokens server-side on logout and clear local credentials.
rules.verification: Runtime test that replays tokens after logout.
rules.evidence: Replay request results showing rejection.

rules.name: Administrative MFA (MASVS-AUTH)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no administrative roles, so administrative MFA does not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Review of identity-provider and admin-login configuration; requires access to the live system.
rules.remediation: Require multi-factor authentication for every administrative account and action.
rules.verification: Manual review of admin authentication configuration.
rules.evidence: Screenshot or export of MFA enforcement settings.

rules.name: OTP Rate Limiting
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no one-time-password flow.
rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: repeated OTP requests and verification attempts must be throttled and locked out.
rules.remediation: Limit OTP generation and verification attempts per account, device and IP; expire codes quickly.
rules.verification: Load/abuse test against OTP endpoints.
rules.evidence: Rate limit responses (HTTP 429) observed in tests.

rules.name: Geographic Access Controls (product-dependent)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no backend on which geographic restrictions could be enforced.
rules.detectionMethod: Cannot be determined automatically: whether geographic restriction is required is a product, legal and threat-model decision.
rules.remediation: Apply geographic restrictions only when the product or legal requirements call for them. This rule is never mandatory.
rules.verification: Human review of product and legal requirements.
rules.evidence: Recorded decision on whether geographic controls are required.

rules.name: Account Enumeration Protection
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no user accounts or no backend, so account enumeration is not a concern.
rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: login, registration and reset responses must not reveal whether an account exists.
rules.remediation: Return uniform responses and timing for existing and non-existing accounts.
rules.verification: Compare responses for known and unknown identifiers.
rules.evidence: Response comparison for existing vs non-existing accounts.

rules.name: Password Reset Security
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no password reset flow.
rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: reset tokens must be single-use, short-lived, unguessable and not leak account existence.
rules.remediation: Use random single-use reset tokens with short expiry and invalidate sessions after reset.
rules.verification: Test of the reset flow against the running backend.
rules.evidence: Reset token expiry and reuse test results.

rules.name: Expensive Endpoint Rate Limiting
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no backend or no AI/expensive endpoints requiring cost-based rate limiting.

officialReference.title: OWASP ASVS V13 API and Web Service

rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: costly endpoints (AI, search, export) must enforce per-user quotas and rate limits.
rules.remediation: Apply per-user and global rate limits and spending caps to expensive endpoints.
rules.verification: Abuse test against expensive endpoints.
rules.evidence: Throttling responses and configured quotas.

rules.name: SSRF Protection
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not fetch user-controlled URLs.

officialReference.title: OWASP ASVS V12 Files and Resources (SSRF)

rules.detectionMethod: Server behaviour test: fetches to internal, loopback and metadata addresses must be blocked, including via redirects and DNS rebinding.
rules.remediation: Use an allow-list of destinations, resolve and validate addresses, disable redirects or re-validate them.
rules.verification: SSRF test payloads against URL-fetching endpoints.
rules.evidence: Blocked request logs for internal address payloads.

rules.name: Secure Storage (MASVS-STORAGE)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project neither processes personal data nor stores authentication tokens.

officialReference.title: Apple Security framework (Keychain Services) / OWASP MASVS-STORAGE

rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for sensitive data written to UserDefaults, plain files or logs instead of the iOS Keychain. Cannot prove runtime behaviour.
rules.remediation: Store credentials and sensitive data in the Keychain with an appropriate accessibility class.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus manual review of data flows.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of insecure storage use.

rules.name: Firebase App Check
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not use Firebase.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for App Check initialisation in the app. Server-side enforcement in Firebase console is not verifiable from source.
rules.remediation: Enable Firebase App Check in the app and enforce it for Firebase services.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus console review for enforcement.
rules.evidence: Presence or absence of App Check initialisation code.

rules.name: Mobile Binary Secret Exposure (MASVS-STORAGE)
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for hardcoded secrets and keys. iOS IPA and Android APK artifacts must be analysed separately; built-artifact analysis is not performed here.
rules.remediation: Remove embedded secrets, rotate any exposed key and fetch secrets from a backend at runtime.
rules.verification: Detector findings on source; separate IPA and APK inspection by a human.
rules.evidence: File, line and redacted secret snippet.

rules.name: Code Hardening (MASVS-RESILIENCE)
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project.
rules.detectionMethod: Cannot be automated: obfuscation is not a security control and hardening depends on the threat model.
rules.remediation: Apply hardening only where the threat model requires it; do not rely on obfuscation for security.
rules.verification: Human review of the threat model and hardening choices.
rules.evidence: Recorded threat-model decision.

rules.name: Secure Token Storage (MASVS-STORAGE)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not store authentication tokens.

officialReference.title: Apple Security framework (Keychain Services) / OWASP MASVS-STORAGE

rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for tokens persisted in UserDefaults, plain files, or logs rather than the Keychain.
rules.remediation: Persist tokens only in the Keychain; never log them.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus manual review.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of insecure token handling.

rules.name: Backup Data Protection (MASVS-STORAGE)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not process personal data.
rules.detectionMethod: Review whether sensitive files are excluded from device backups; requires knowledge of data classification.
rules.remediation: Exclude sensitive files from backups and use data protection classes.
rules.verification: Manual review of file storage locations and backup flags.
rules.evidence: List of sensitive files and backup exclusion status.

rules.name: Deep Link Validation (MASVS-PLATFORM)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project does not handle deep links or universal links.
rules.detectionMethod: Review of deep link handlers for input validation and authentication checks; requires data-flow analysis.
rules.remediation: Validate and sanitise all deep link parameters; use universal links and require authentication for sensitive actions.
rules.verification: Manual review and runtime test of link handlers.
rules.evidence: Handler code references and test results.

rules.name: TLS & Certificate Validation (MASVS-NETWORK)
rules.notApplicableReason: The project neither calls external APIs nor has a backend, so there is no network traffic to protect.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for disabled TLS validation, cleartext HTTP exceptions and trust-all handlers. Certificate pinning is required only if the threat model needs it.
rules.remediation: Remove TLS bypasses and ATS exceptions; add pinning only when justified by the threat model.
rules.verification: Detector findings on source.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of TLS bypass.

rules.name: Least Privilege (MASVS-PLATFORM)
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project.
rules.detectionMethod: Cannot be determined automatically: requires review of permissions, entitlements and service roles against actual needs.
rules.remediation: Request only the permissions, entitlements and roles the product actually needs.
rules.verification: Human review of permissions and entitlements.
rules.evidence: Permission inventory with justification.

rules.name: Environment File Protection
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project repository.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for committed .env files and missing .gitignore entries for them.
rules.remediation: Add .env patterns to .gitignore, remove committed files and rotate exposed secrets.
rules.verification: Detector findings on the workspace file list.
rules.evidence: Path of the committed env file or missing ignore pattern.

rules.name: Dependency Management
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project repository.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for a committed lockfile and obviously unmanaged or permanently pinned old dependency versions. Vulnerability scanning results are not evaluated.
rules.remediation: Commit lockfiles, run a vulnerability scan, update dependencies in a controlled manner and avoid permanent pinning to old versions.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus separate vulnerability scan.
rules.evidence: Lockfile presence and flagged dependency specifiers.

rules.name: Installation Script Security
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to every project repository.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for piped remote scripts (curl | sh) and unverified downloads in install scripts.
rules.remediation: Verify checksums or signatures of downloaded scripts and avoid piping remote content to a shell.
rules.verification: Detector findings on scripts.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of the unsafe install command.

rules.name: Fork & Pull Request Secret Protection
rules.notApplicableReason: The project has no CI workflows.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan of workflow files for pull_request_target with untrusted checkout and secret exposure to forked pull requests.
rules.remediation: Avoid pull_request_target with untrusted code; do not expose secrets to fork workflows.
rules.verification: Detector findings on workflow files.
rules.evidence: Workflow file, line and snippet.

rules.name: Prompt Injection Defense
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to the Studio AI engine in every workspace.

officialReference.title: OWASP ASVS V5 Validation (untrusted input handling)

rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for untrusted content concatenated into agent instructions or executed without a trust boundary. Cannot prove runtime robustness.
rules.remediation: Separate instructions from untrusted data, require approval for actions derived from untrusted content.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus red-team review.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of unguarded untrusted input.

rules.name: AI Agent Least Privilege
rules.notApplicableReason: This rule applies to the Studio AI engine in every workspace.
rules.detectionMethod: Source scan for unrestricted tool, file or shell access and missing approval gates in agent configuration.
rules.remediation: Grant agents the minimum tools, paths and credentials, with human approval for destructive actions.
rules.verification: Detector findings plus configuration review.
rules.evidence: File, line and snippet of broad agent permissions.
